original.text_md:
## Author announcement — Sardor (@sardorml) Source: https://x.com/sardorml/status/2118616954085024133 I built CaptureFlow, an open-source screen recorder for you and your AI agents. Record your screen in Chrome and get a link you can share with anyone. Or let your agent record the demo over #MCP. Self-host it with Docker. https://t.co/GwIkaJEH9C #opensource #buildinpublic https://t.co/dlOESaA0wJ ## Public reply context — @progerallworld (not the author) Source: https://x.com/progerallworld/status/2118618493977313326 @sardorml This could be useful for bug reports too: agent reproduces the issue, records the steps, attaches the clip. Much easier to review than “I clicked around and it broke” 😅 ## Author reply — Sardor (@sardorml) Source: https://x.com/sardorml/status/2118619339041755560 @progerallworld Yes, definitely. That's the use case i had in mind when i added the MCP. ## Author reply — Sardor (@sardorml) Source: https://x.com/sardorml/status/2118621775856865775 @progerallworld You can also ask it record a demo for your github pull request and it will attach it to the pr description. With extension installed reviewers can watch the demo to get a better idea of the changes. ## Linked README — complete text, fixed source snapshot Source: https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow/blob/c5792345e7d5e47084c5e829b3f11c98a432c859/README.md

CaptureFlow

Open-source screen recorder with instant share links, self-hostable on your own Cloudflare account. [![CI status][ci-image]][ci-url] [![License: AGPL-3.0][license-image]][license-url] [![Chrome Web Store][chrome-image]][chrome-url] [![Stars][stars-image]][stars-url] [![Discord][discord-image]][discord-url] [Website][website-url] · [Docs][docs-url] · [Blog][blog-url] · [Report Bug][issues-url] · [Request Feature][feature-url] [ci-image]: https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg [ci-url]: https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow/actions/workflows/ci.yml [license-image]: https://img.shields.io/badge/license-AGPL--3.0-2563EB.svg?style=flat-square [license-url]: ./LICENSE [chrome-image]: https://img.shields.io/chrome-web-store/v/lgpgeoelaokbigdljofhkgbfnfcnmcol?label=chrome%20web%20store&color=2563EB&style=flat-square [chrome-url]: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/lgpgeoelaokbigdljofhkgbfnfcnmcol [stars-image]: https://img.shields.io/github/stars/sardorml/captureflow?color=2563EB&style=flat-square [stars-url]: https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow/stargazers [discord-image]: https://img.shields.io/badge/chat-discord-5865F2.svg?style=flat-square [discord-url]: https://discord.gg/qzeBCaEeNq [website-url]: https://captureflow.dev [docs-url]: https://docs.captureflow.dev [blog-url]: https://captureflow.dev/blog [issues-url]: https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow/issues/new [feature-url]: https://captureflow.dev/suggest-feature
[![CaptureFlow: open-source screen recorder with shareable links, above the recordings dashboard](.github/assets/readme-hero.png)](https://captureflow.dev) ## ✨ Features - 🔗 The share link is ready the moment you stop: the upload runs while you record. - 🎥 Record a tab, a window or your whole screen, with camera bubble and mic. - 💬 Viewers react with emoji and comment right on the video, and you see who watched. - 🖼 Annotated screenshots with arrows, text and blur, shared by the same kind of link. - 👥 Workspaces for your team, with public, workspace-only or private visibility. - 💸 Priced by storage for the whole team, never per seat. - ☁️ Self-host on your own Cloudflare account, with sign-in limited to your company. - 🔓 Every feature ships in the open-source build. ## 🖥 Where it runs | Surface | Status | | ------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | | Chrome extension | Available on the [Chrome Web Store][chrome-url] | | macOS app | Build from source; signed release coming soon | | Web dashboard and viewers | Any modern browser | ## 📦 Get started - **Hosted:** [create a free account](https://captureflow.dev/login?mode=signup) and install the [Chrome extension][chrome-url]. Paid plans add 100 GB, 500 GB or 1 TB for the whole team; see [pricing](https://captureflow.dev/pricing). - **Self-hosted:** `docker compose up` on your own server, or run it on your own Cloudflare account (Workers, D1 and R2). Follow the [step-by-step guide](https://captureflow.dev/blog/self-hosted-screen-recorder), or [let us set it up for you](https://captureflow.dev/self-host-setup). ## ☁️ Self-hosting ### Docker ```bash cp .env.example .env # set APP_URL docker compose up -d ``` Everything lives in `./data`: a SQLite database, the recordings on disk, and secrets generated on first start. You don't need a Cloudflare account. Transcripts can use any OpenAI-compatible Whisper server, including one compose runs for you with `--profile whisper`. See the [Docker guide](https://docs.captureflow.dev/self-hosting/docker). ### Cloudflare [![Deploy to Cloudflare](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/button)](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/?url=https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow) Or manually: ```bash pnpm --filter @captureflow/web exec wrangler d1 create captureflow pnpm --filter @captureflow/web exec wrangler r2 bucket create captureflow-recordings # paste the database id into apps/web/wrangler.jsonc, then: pnpm --filter @captureflow/web db:apply:remote pnpm --filter @captureflow/web cf:deploy ``` [`DEPLOY.md`](./DEPLOY.md) is the full runbook: secrets, sign-in providers, custom domains, and pointing the extension and desktop app at your own instance. A deployment on your own domain runs as a self-hosted instance; to make it a private company tool, set `ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS` as described in the [configuration docs](https://docs.captureflow.dev/self-hosting/configuration). ## ⌨️ Development Requires Node.js 24.13 or newer and pnpm 10 (`corepack enable`). ```bash git clone git@github.com:sardorml/captureflow.git cd captureflow pnpm install pnpm web # dashboard and landing on http://localhost:3032 pnpm admin # instance admin on http://localhost:3034 pnpm extension # browser extension, in a fresh Chrome profile pnpm --filter @captureflow/desktop dev # macOS recorder ``` Checks: ```bash pnpm typecheck pnpm --filter @captureflow/web test pnpm --filter @captureflow/extension test pnpm format ```
Monorepo layout ``` apps/ web/ Next.js 16 landing, blog, dashboard, viewers and API → Cloudflare Workers (OpenNext) admin/ Instance-admin Worker on its own host, bound to the same D1 and R2 mailer/ Product-email Worker: sends admin-written campaigns via Resend, handles unsubscribe extension/ Browser recorder (WXT, MV3): panel, offscreen capture, in-page controls desktop/ Electron screen recorder (macOS) docs/ VitePress documentation site packages/ engine/ Capture engine shared by desktop and extension: macOS sidecars, record protocol, mux (MIT) admin/ Admin auth and data logic behind apps/admin mail/ Campaigns, email rendering, unsubscribe tokens, Resend delivery, transactional sends quota/ Storage quota, limits and workspace logic shared/ Types and constants shared across the apps ui/ Theme tokens and the React components with no HeroUI equivalent ``` Apps depend on packages, never the reverse, and never on each other. The macOS capture sidecars are committed as built binaries. After editing the Swift sources, rebuild them with `packages/engine/scripts/build-native.sh` (add `--universal` for arm64 + x86_64).
## 🔗 Links - [Website](https://captureflow.dev) - [Documentation](https://docs.captureflow.dev) - [Self-hosting docs](https://docs.captureflow.dev/self-hosting/overview) - [Blog](https://captureflow.dev/blog) - [Pricing](https://captureflow.dev/pricing) - [FAQ](https://captureflow.dev/faq) - [Security](https://captureflow.dev/security) - [Releases](https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow/releases) - [Discord][discord-url] ## 🤝 Contributing [![PRs Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow/pulls) Bug reports, ideas and pull requests are all welcome. Open an [issue][issues-url], [suggest a feature][feature-url], or send a pull request. Read [`CONVENTIONS.md`](./CONVENTIONS.md) first: it's the standard every change follows. Found a security issue? Please report it privately as described on the [security page](https://captureflow.dev/security), not in a public issue. ## 📄 License [AGPL-3.0-only](./LICENSE), with one exception: the reusable capture engine in [`packages/engine`](./packages/engine) is [MIT-licensed](./packages/engine/LICENSE). Combined builds (the desktop app and the browser extension) are AGPL-3.0-only as a whole.
Back to top ↑

body_md:
Sardor 在 11 月 6 日介绍了自己做的开源录屏工具 CaptureFlow：人在 Chrome 里录屏，结束后把链接发给别人；AI Agent 也可以通过 MCP 录制演示。它支持 Docker 自托管。原帖所链接的仓库 README 进一步写明，录制过程中就会上传，停止录制时分享链接已经准备好了。

## 能录什么，在哪里使用

CaptureFlow 可以录制浏览器标签页、窗口或整个屏幕，并加入摄像头悬浮画面和麦克风声音。观看者可以在视频里发表情、留言，录制者能看到谁看过。截图也可以加箭头、文字和模糊遮挡，再用同样的链接方式分享。

团队使用工作区管理内容，可设为公开、仅工作区成员可见或私密。托管服务按整个团队的存储量收费，不按席位收费；付费方案提供 100 GB、500 GB 或 1 TB 存储空间。作者说明，全部功能都包含在开源构建中，也可以部署到自己的 Cloudflare 账户，并把登录范围限制在公司内。

Chrome 扩展已经在 [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/lgpgeoelaokbigdljofhkgbfnfcnmcol) 上架。macOS 应用目前可以从源码构建，签名发行版仍是即将推出的状态；网页管理台和观看页支持现代浏览器。托管版可以先[注册免费账户](https://captureflow.dev/login?mode=signup)，再安装扩展，具体付费额度见[价格页](https://captureflow.dev/pricing)。

在原帖评论里，@progerallworld 提出的用途是让 Agent 重现 Bug、录下步骤，再附上视频。Sardor 回复说，这正是他加入 MCP 时考虑的场景。随后他又补充，也可以让 Agent 为 GitHub Pull Request 录制演示，并附到 PR 描述里；安装扩展后，审阅者可以观看演示来理解改动。这是作者对用途的说明，本轮没有连接 MCP 或试录视频。

## 用 Docker 部署

README 给出的 Docker 启动方式很短：先执行 `cp .env.example .env`，设置 `APP_URL`，再执行 `docker compose up -d`。

数据都保存在 `./data`：SQLite 数据库、磁盘上的录屏文件，以及第一次启动时生成的密钥。这条部署路线不需要 Cloudflare 账户。生成转写可以使用兼容 OpenAI 接口的 Whisper 服务；Compose 也提供 `--profile whisper` 来运行一个这样的服务。完整说明在 [Docker 部署文档](https://docs.captureflow.dev/self-hosting/docker)。

## 部署到自己的 Cloudflare 账户

另一条路线使用 Cloudflare Workers、D1 和 R2。仓库提供了[一键部署入口](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/?url=https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow)，也列出了手动步骤。

先运行 `pnpm --filter @captureflow/web exec wrangler d1 create captureflow` 创建数据库，再运行 `pnpm --filter @captureflow/web exec wrangler r2 bucket create captureflow-recordings` 创建存储桶。把数据库 ID 填入 `apps/web/wrangler.jsonc` 后，依次执行 `pnpm --filter @captureflow/web db:apply:remote` 和 `pnpm --filter @captureflow/web cf:deploy`。

[DEPLOY.md](https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow/blob/c5792345e7d5e47084c5e829b3f11c98a432c859/DEPLOY.md) 说明了密钥、登录服务、自定义域名，以及如何让扩展和桌面应用连接自己的实例。部署在自己的域名下会作为自托管实例运行；如果要做成公司内部工具，还需要按照[配置文档](https://docs.captureflow.dev/self-hosting/configuration)设置 `ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS`。仓库也链接了[逐步自托管教程](https://captureflow.dev/blog/self-hosted-screen-recorder)和[代配置服务](https://captureflow.dev/self-host-setup)。

## 本地开发和检查

开发环境需要 Node.js 24.13 或更新版本，以及 pnpm 10；README 提示用 `corepack enable` 启用。取得仓库并进入目录后，先执行 `pnpm install`。

完整的取代码命令是 `git clone git@github.com:sardorml/captureflow.git`，接着执行 `cd captureflow`。`pnpm web` 启动网页管理台和官网，地址为 `http://localhost:3032`；`pnpm admin` 启动实例管理后台，地址为 `http://localhost:3034`。`pnpm extension` 会在一个新的 Chrome 配置环境中启动浏览器扩展；macOS 录屏应用的开发命令是 `pnpm --filter @captureflow/desktop dev`。

仓库列出的检查命令分别是 `pnpm typecheck`、`pnpm --filter @captureflow/web test`、`pnpm --filter @captureflow/extension test` 和 `pnpm format`。这里保留的是作者提供的命令，没有把文档中的检查项写成本站已经跑过的结果。

## 仓库如何拆分

应用放在 `apps/`，共享包放在 `packages/`。依赖方向有明确约束：应用可以依赖共享包，共享包不能反向依赖应用，应用之间也不能互相依赖。

- `apps/web` 使用 Next.js 16，包含官网、博客、管理台、观看页和 API，通过 OpenNext 部署到 Cloudflare Workers。
- `apps/admin` 是运行在独立主机名下的实例管理 Worker，与主应用绑定同一组 D1 和 R2。
- `apps/mailer` 是产品邮件 Worker，通过 Resend 发送管理员编写的邮件活动，并处理退订。
- `apps/extension` 是基于 WXT、MV3 的浏览器录屏扩展，包含面板、离屏采集和页面内控制。
- `apps/desktop` 是基于 Electron 的 macOS 录屏应用；`apps/docs` 是 VitePress 文档站。
- `packages/engine` 是桌面端与扩展共用的采集引擎，包含 macOS 辅助程序、录制协议和封装处理，采用 MIT 许可。
- `packages/admin` 为管理后台提供认证与数据逻辑；`packages/mail` 负责邮件活动、渲染、退订令牌、Resend 投递和事务邮件。
- `packages/quota` 管理存储额度、限制与工作区；`packages/shared` 放各应用共享的类型和常量；`packages/ui` 放主题令牌，以及没有对应 HeroUI 组件的 React 组件。

macOS 采集辅助程序以编译后的二进制文件形式存入仓库。修改 Swift 源码后，需要运行 `packages/engine/scripts/build-native.sh` 重新构建；加上 `--universal` 可以同时支持 arm64 和 x86_64。

## 文档、贡献和许可

项目的[官网](https://captureflow.dev)、[文档](https://docs.captureflow.dev)、[自托管总览](https://docs.captureflow.dev/self-hosting/overview)、[博客](https://captureflow.dev/blog)、[FAQ](https://captureflow.dev/faq)、[安全说明](https://captureflow.dev/security)、[发行记录](https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow/releases)和 [Discord](https://discord.gg/qzeBCaEeNq) 均由 README 提供入口。

作者欢迎 Bug 报告、想法和 Pull Request，可以到[仓库 Issues](https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow/issues/new)或[功能建议页](https://captureflow.dev/suggest-feature)提交。贡献前需要阅读 [CONVENTIONS.md](https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow/blob/c5792345e7d5e47084c5e829b3f11c98a432c859/CONVENTIONS.md)。发现安全问题应按照安全页说明私下报告，不要发到公开 Issue。

项目采用 [AGPL-3.0-only](https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow/blob/c5792345e7d5e47084c5e829b3f11c98a432c859/LICENSE)，例外是可复用的采集引擎 `packages/engine`，它采用 [MIT](https://github.com/sardorml/captureflow/blob/c5792345e7d5e47084c5e829b3f11c98a432c859/packages/engine/LICENSE) 许可。桌面应用与浏览器扩展的组合构建，整体仍适用 AGPL-3.0-only。

本文完整改写上述作者帖文、已取得的作者回复及固定版本 README；README 最近修改于 11 月 4 日，不能把 11 月 6 日的介绍帖当成当天发布新版本。文档文字按上游 AGPL-3.0-only 许可使用，[许可全文](https://xnews.qiaomu.ai/source-licenses/captureflow-AGPL-3.0.txt)随站点提供；本站中文不是官方文档。
